entry_points.text: Module notifier allocates per-CPU reader state on arrival and frees on departure with warnings on failure or residual readers; a static block dispatches coming/going. Sync helper queues completion hurried; completion runs after grace to advance, requeue or idle with misuse detection.

Task thread prepares timers and urgency, restricts to housekeeping CPUs, publishes itself then loops single iterations with idle sleeps; iteration waits for callbacks, brackets flavour grace with markers and invokes from CPU zero. Timer and work helpers funnel to invocation which spreads to successors, extracts completed entries with bottom-half exclusion and re-accelerates survivors.

Generic spawner starts flavour thread with derived name and warns on failure; classic wires sleeps, lazy handling and scan callbacks, rude sets sleep, then generic init spawns enabled flavours and runs selftests. Tiny init opens softirq, runs early tests and inits task lists; verification schedules delayed rechecks while pending.

Irq-work hook ignores virtual CPUs, tries deferred no-callback wakeup and queues late wakeup when reschedule pending. Entry/exit checks validate nesting and watching, enabling tick dependency for full-nohz urgent CPUs. CPU-need is true only with non-empty local list and no offload.

exports.text: Blocking coordination object offers init, enter, exit and destroy; enter sleeps until a grace elapses except the first entrant completes synchronously, and hurried queueing requests prompt observation of transitions.

Snapshot returns current grace sequence and poll reports completion on reserved marker or sequence advance, tree ordering grace before later accesses; lightweight readers expose normal, expedited and wrap counts plus start-poll helpers.

Classic and rude task flavours provide blocking waits until pre-existing tasks quiesce, barriers draining prior callbacks, thread-handle exposure and state reporting; tracing reports completed batches via its sleepable helper.

Quiescent reporting covers softirq, tiny user/kernel and scheduler paths with sequence advance and reschedule hints; helpers report CPU online state and request urgent quiescence. Boot sizes sleepable objects, drains boot list, brackets exiting tasks and inits task lists.

hazards.text: One-time warnings flag module alloc failure, residual readers, sync completion from idle/passed, inconsistent nesting, destroy with registrants, kthread creation failure, signals on grace thread and selftest timeout. Grace iterations and barriers may sleep and forbid non-sleep contexts except early-boot direct path; barriers rely on mutex against overlap.

Zero-in-quiescent check orders remote watching reads with barriers, fails on nonzero and succeeds only if unchanged to avoid false attribution. Slow-path registration warns on duplicates or mismatched unregister and delays only when unsuppressed and aligned. Collapse asserts no callbacks outside CPU zero; pre-scheduler sync warns and returns.

invariants.text: Boot records sizing then flags completion before draining boot list without double queue; module arrival installs per-CPU state and initial bank, departure frees only when no grace or readers remain. Nesting is zero exactly when idle; first entrant drives completion, final exiter drives exit; destroy needs empty nesting, folds replay and waits only if not idle.

Enqueue limits start at one with shift from possible CPUs; adaptive mode collapses enqueue then dequeue to CPU zero across a grace. Urgency applies only with lazy batching and non-empty lists, set by timers and consumed per scan. Thread pointer publishes with release after timers and affinity; reserved marker always polls complete.

Classic grace brackets scanning with waits ordering scheduler transitions; holdout means runnable on CPU excluding voluntary sleepers, boot-excepted idle loops and offline idle. Scanning refs holdouts, snapshots switch counts and merges exit lists with pauses; recheck releases cleared or switched tasks else nudges and logs. Rude forces quiescence via per-CPU work; waiting backs off to periodic sleeps with growing info then stall reports.

Global state starts idle with biased sequence and initialised locks and cleanup work; topology controls fanout, levels and debug delays. Force-quiescent timing starts disabled with divisor seven; params clamp to one second and one tick. Wrap lag defaults to quarter space with clamp on catch-up; watching snapshots use acquire ordering and idle counts as acknowledged quiescence.

locks.text: Coordination state and nesting share the wait-queue guard held with interrupt exclusion for decisions, updates and wakeups. Tiny sequence and lists use interrupt save/restore against interrupts and softirq.

Each per-CPU queue has its own raw guard with interrupt exclusion for short list work, releasing across rescheduling via placeholder. Global guard covers collapse limits; grace mutex serialises whole iterations and barrier mutex serialises entrainment, never held across sleeps with per-CPU guards.

Deferred no-callback wakeup checks threshold locklessly then rechecks under group lock before waking the grace thread with tracing. Full-nohz urgent tick enable re-evaluates need flags under node lock with interrupts disabled and watching active.

state_machines.text: Sync cycles idle-enter-passed-exit-idle with replay for exit races; entered readers sleep till passed, completion advances or requeues, teardown folds replay to exit. Barrier snapshots sequence, entrains one marker per active queue with base count two and sleeps till the last completes.

Grace thread walks init, callback/grace waits, pre-wait, scan, post-scan, holdout waits/scans, post-grace, reader wait, invoke and final wait, timestamping each for stall detection. Queues move enqueue-accelerate-advance-ready-invoke with need bits; classic wait moves pre-wait, scan, post-scan, repeated holdout scans, post-grace.

Idle classifier separates nested versus single-level idle interrupts, task context by watching, and underflow warns with interrupts disabled. Snapshot recheck accepts stopped or re-entered idle, releases offline, escalates urgent to heavy requests and hammers lagging CPUs once per grace. Sync completion verifies full grace, completes waiter, drains count and unlatches; cleanup detaches done chain and recycles heads.

structs.text: Per-CPU task record holds callback list and guard, activity stamps, lazy timer and urgency, work and irq-work, barrier head and blocked/exit sets with CPU identity. Central control holds wait channel, guards and grace mutex, progress markers, thread pointer, flavour callbacks, enqueue/dequeue limits and barrier state with names. Tiny block holds head, completed/all tails and biased sequence; sync wait-head pool is a fixed array with atomic flags and range membership.

ABI facts: sync markers idle0 enter1 passed2 exit3 replay4; task diagnostic states 0..11 in order; tiny sequence bias 300 below zero with advance 2 per report; lazy quarter second and classic sleep tenth HZ; stall boot 30s runtime 10m x3 info 10s; batch 10/1000 high 10000 low 100 overload 20000; pacing 3 periods, latch 64, reschedule 3ms, divisor 7.
